title: Account lockout lifecycle
requirements: Track failed sign-in attempts per account.
Lock the account after the configured threshold.
Allow an administrator to unlock the account.

title: Tenant deletion authorization
requirements: Only tenant owners may request tenant deletion.
Deletion must be recorded before asynchronous cleanup starts.
Cleanup must never access another tenant's records.

title: Payment request idempotency
requirements: Accept an idempotency key for payment creation.
Return the original result for a repeated key and payload.
Reject a repeated key with a different payload.

title: Upload screen states
requirements: Show upload progress without blocking navigation.
Allow a failed upload to be retried.
Show a completed file in the list exactly once.

title: Backward-compatible schema migration
requirements: Add the preference column without locking reads.
Backfill existing rows before making the column required.
Provide a tested rollback for each migration phase.

title: Webhook retry state machine
requirements: Retry transient failures with a bounded schedule.
Never retry a terminal client rejection.

title: Cache invalidation after writes
requirements: Invalidate the item cache after a successful write.
Do not invalidate when the write transaction rolls back.

title: Membership role transitions
requirements: An owner may promote a member to administrator.
The final owner cannot demote themselves.
Every role transition must be audited.

title: Offline draft synchronization
requirements: Save editor changes locally while offline.
Sync the draft after connectivity returns.
Surface a conflict instead of overwriting a newer server revision.

title: Per-tenant API rate limit
requirements: Return a retry-after value when a request is rejected.
Internal health checks must not consume tenant quota.

title: Cancelable data export
requirements: Create large exports as background jobs.
Allow the requesting user to cancel a running export.

title: Feature rollout and rollback
requirements: Enable the feature for a configured percentage of accounts.
Keep account assignment stable during the rollout.
Disable the feature globally without a deployment.
